text:
marta (community): Quick heads-up: we just posted a few coordinated updates for OSS maintainers + community localization. TL;DR: Maintainer rotation schedule published, Contributor Guidelines v2 released, and a 48-hour L10N hackathon next month. Sign-up + details: https://rwd.co/l10n-hack :tada:

sarah (eng-oss): Awesome! link to the maintainer rotation?

marta (community): Here it is: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#rotation -- new process reduces on-call churn and formalizes handover notes. Please read before you volunteer.

leila (i18n): We also added a translation playbook and a small TM (translation memory) export so contributors can reuse previous strings. Docs: https://rwd.co/i18n-playbook

ryan (product): Nice. Are there bounties or swag for top contributors during the hackathon?

marta (community): Yes — small grant pool + stickers + priority review for significant PRs. See the hackathon section of the announcement for criteria. We'll also feature winners in the community newsletter.

daniel (maintainer): I'll be the lead maintainer for the first rotation window (May 4-17). I'll host an async office hour on May 6 16:00 UTC for onboarding new maintainers.

leila (i18n): Can we get timezone-friendly slots? My volunteers are across APAC. Maybe run two office hours?

marta (community): Good call — adding a second slot: May 7 02:00 UTC. Both will be recorded and notes posted.

sarah (eng-oss): Quick question on Contributor Guidelines v2: is there an updated checklist for PR readiness?

marta (community): Yes — v2 includes a PR checklist (see the bottom of the guidelines). Highlights: automated linting + CI labels, i18n-ready strings, and a lightweight changelog entry. Example snippet: 
```
- Add changelog entry under /CHANGELOG.md
- Run `yarn test` and `yarn lint:docs`
- Mark PR with `i18n-needed` if user-facing text changed
```

dev-bot: Event created: "L10N Hackathon" (2026-05-08 00:00 UTC -> 2026-05-09 23:59 UTC). Calendar invite sent to #community.

leila (i18n): We'll bring starter tasks (translation pairs, UI strings, README localization). Also prepping quick guides for reviewers.

ryan (product): I'll coordinate priority triage for PRs that enable dedicated customer workflows (we promised a few in partner previews).

marta (community): If you want to volunteer as a mentor during the hackathon, please add your GitHub handle to the spreadsheet: https://rwd.co/l10n-vols. Deadline to sign up: April 30.

sarah (eng-oss): Signed up. 

daniel (maintainer): Thanks — I'll make a `good-first-l10n` label and a small starter issue template.

marta (community): Final note: Contributor Guidelines v2 is effective immediately. Small edits are fine, but please open PRs for policy changes rather than thread debates. We'll run a follow-up AMA after the hackathon. :sparkles:
